_comment: Save as /config/tracker-preset.json. Every value here is a placeholder for a fictional site: replace them. An empty value leaves that field alone. TRACKER_SESSION, TRACKER_VIP, TRACKER_PROXY, TRACKER_HOME_IP and TRACKER_EXPECTED_EGRESS_IP are yours and are refused if they appear here. "categories" is optional: the tracker's own search-category values and what to call them; with it, Search category becomes a dropdown.
label: Example tracker
